The row's hazards line is the canyon-wide template - left alone.

wa_snow_creek_wall_medusa_s_roof.notes: CATALOG DEFECT (suspected misfiled or phantom row). Added by the 2026-10-02 WA guidebook audit (scripts/rollback-add-guidebook-routes-1790927493042.json). Neither Mountain Project's Snow Creek Wall list (16 routes), theCrag's Snow Creek Wall list (29 routes) nor Steph Abegg's Snow Creek Wall page names a 'Medusa's Roof'. The name is the known P12 roof on Liberty Bell's East Face / Freedom Rider (Washington Pass; audits/route-breakdown/2026-09-24-batch-B.json), and the row's commitment 'V' fits a long Washington Pass wall, not an 800 ft Snow Creek Wall line. Grade 5.10b, commitment V and guide_stars 2 have no source I could open. No fixes proposed; the owner decides whether the row is real.
